metrics.visualTitle: Broj stavki prior by department and order_dow

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'departments'[department],
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('orders'[order_dow], "IsGrandTotalColumnTotal"),
			"Broj_stavki_prior", 'order_products_prior'[Broj stavki prior]
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = FALSE)),
			"'departments'[department]", 'departments'[department],
			"'orders'[order_dow]", 'orders'[order_dow],
			"Broj_stavki_prior", [Broj_stavki_prior]
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreTableByDM0 = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = TRUE)),
			"'departments'[department]", 'departments'[department],
			"SortBy_DM0_0", [Broj_stavki_prior]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'departments'[department]),
			__DS0CoreTableByDM0
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(201, __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns, [SortBy_DM0_0], 0, 'departments'[department], 1)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals, 'orders'[order_dow])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(62, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'orders'[order_dow], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'orders'[order_dow],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'orders'[order_dow]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[SortBy_DM0_0] DESC, 'departments'[department], [ColumnIndex]
